name: OCL Mapper
what_it_is: A collaborative web UI (beta) for mapping spreadsheet-based source terminologies to standard target terminologies (LOINC, CIEL, ICD-10) stored in an OCL Terminology Server, using AI-assisted vector-embedding matching to rank mapping candidates.
components: OCL Terminology Server (external, provides AI matching)
protocols: REST API to OCL Terminology Server
measurement: ~60% improvement vs string matching on CIEL datasets
constraints: CORS must match API_URL in production
